title: Can Can Bunny Premiere
native_title: きゃんきゃんバニー プルミエール
overview:
A heart-pounding romance adventure game

Crying, laughing, getting angry... a girl's feelings are delicate!

The Seven Lucky Gods back you up in your love troubles!

You are an ordinary young man working at a restaurant, and one evening you come home to find seven odd creatures sitting at your table. Before you can throw them out, the green-haired goddess Swatty appears. The strangers are the Seven Lucky Gods under her command, and she decides to help you, a lonely guy, find a girlfriend.

Meet a range of girls around town, choose your words carefully, and watch how each one reacts. Your choices at branching points decide how well things go with each of them.

- Supports the Shuttle Mouse

ときめきの恋愛アドベンチャーゲーム

泣いたり、笑ったり、怒ったり…女の子のキモチは微妙！

七福神が恋のトラブルバックアップ！
